name: ending-victory
description: The ending, won: twenty-four of the player's tanks appear next to the enemy command centre on Big Arena and raze the base, so the match is won. The real ending is on (match_end): the HUD goes, the camera holds on the deciding blow under a VICTORY banner in slow motion, then the results come up with kills and losses. Checks the match_end, hold and ending events, the end state the harness reports and that the player was credited with kills. Screenshots: one during the hold, one with the results up.
